test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the main cause of plastic bag pollution?

options.text: Their widespread use and slow degradation

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main cause of plastic bag pollution is their **widespread use** and **slow degradation**.
 
• Plastic bags are distributed freely at stores and used for only a short period before disposal.
 
• They take hundreds of years to decompose, leading to long-term environmental pollution.
 
• Plastic bags contribute to marine pollution, harming wildlife and ecosystems.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Careful recycling** – Incorrect because recycling is a solution, not a cause of plastic pollution.
 
• **Option 2: Their easy decomposition** – Incorrect because plastic bags take a long time to decompose, contributing to pollution.
 
• **Option 3: Lots of proper disposal methods** – Incorrect because plastic bags are often improperly disposed of, leading to pollution.
